Few-shot object detection aims to accurately identify and localize objects of novel classes using only a limited number of annotated samples, presenting significant challenges due to data scarcity and the complex variability of real-world scenes. This paper proposes a novel framework, Dense Relation Distillation with Context-aware Aggregation (DRD-CA), to address these challenges by enhancing feature representation and relational reasoning between images. Our approach introduces a dense relation distillation module that comprehensively captures interactions across multi-level features between support and query samples, facilitating robust transfer of semantic information even in low-data regimes. Further, we incorporate a context-aware aggregation mechanism that adaptively integrates contextual cues from the scene, improving object distinction and reducing false positives. Extensive experiments on standard few-shot object detection benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches in both detection accuracy and generalization ability. The DRD-CA framework thus advances the reliability and applicability of few-shot object detection, with potential extensions to related tasks in low-resource learning environments. Keywords: few-shot object detection, dense relation distillation, context-aware aggregation, feature learning, semantic transfer, deep learning.

Time series data constitutes a distinct and growing problem in machine learning. As the corpus of time series data grows larger, deep models that simultaneously learn features and classify with these features can be intractable or suboptimal. In this paper, we present feature learning via long short term memory (LSTM) networks and prediction via gradient boosting trees (XGB). Focusing on the consequential setting of electronic health record data, we predict the occurrence of hypoxemia five minutes into the future based on past features. We make two observations: 1) long short term memory networks are effective at capturing long term dependencies based on a single feature and 2) gradient boosting trees are capable of tractably combining a large number of features including static features like height and weight. With these observations in mind, we generate features by performing "supervised" representation learning with LSTM networks. Augmenting the original XGB model with these features gives significantly better performance than either individual method.

This paper addresses the challenge of optimizing multi-agent systems using game-theoretic approaches, focusing on the development of a gradient-based method leveraging the Nikaido-Isoda function. The objective is to provide an efficient and scalable solution for computing Nash equilibria in non-cooperative games, which are critical in applications such as resource allocation, autonomous systems, and adversarial learning. We propose a novel algorithm that integrates gradient descent techniques with the Nikaido-Isoda function to iteratively approximate equilibrium points, ensuring convergence under mild assumptions. Our approach is computationally efficient, avoiding the need for exhaustive search or complex heuristics. Experimental results demonstrate the algorithm's superior performance in terms of convergence speed and accuracy compared to existing methods, particularly in high-dimensional and large-scale scenarios. The proposed method also exhibits robustness to varying game structures and initial conditions. This work contributes to the field of game theory by providing a practical and theoretically grounded tool for equilibrium computation, with potential applications in AI, economics, and multi-agent systems. Key innovations include the integration of gradient-based optimization with the Nikaido-Isoda framework and the demonstration of its scalability. Keywords: game theory, Nash equilibrium, Nikaido-Isoda function, gradient-based optimization, multi-agent systems.

This paper investigates the challenge of evaluating the synthesizability of dynamic texture samples, a pivotal element in enhancing immersive experiences in various computer graphics applications. The ability to automatically determine which samples can be effectively synthesized is crucial for efficient and high-quality texture generation. Methods/Approach: We propose a novel computational model that leverages machine learning techniques to predict the synthesizability of dynamic textures. Our approach involves the use of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to extract spatiotemporal features, combined with a classification framework to assess the synthesizability likelihood of given texture samples. The model is trained on a carefully curated dataset of dynamic textures, allowing it to learn complex patterns and variations pertinent to dynamic texture synthesis. Results/Findings: The proposed model achieved notable accuracy in predicting the synthesizability of dynamic textures, surpassing traditional heuristic-based methods. Our findings illustrate that the model can effectively differentiate between high and low synthesizability samples, providing substantial improvements in texture quality and synthesis speed in generative applications. Comparative evaluations demonstrate the model's robustness and generalization across diverse texture categories. Conclusion/Implications: This research introduces an effective tool for dynamic texture analysis, marking a significant contribution to the fields of computer graphics and texture synthesis. By streamlining the selection process for texture samples, the model facilitates enhanced visual fidelity and performance in real-time rendering applications. Future work may explore extending the framework to incorporate user-defined criteria for custom texture applications, broadening its utility and impact. Keywords: dynamic textures, texture synthesis, synthesizability prediction, machine learning, convolutional neural networks, computer graphics.

In a recent work, to tackle the continual image classification task, investigated the transferability of the the learned features by using spectral decomposition on the representation space. The experiment is designed to illustrate the sensitivity of each spectral component in the representation space. In detail, the learner is trained with only two consequence tasks then they monitor how each eigenvalue adjusts after learning the second task. Dataset from the first task is feed into two version of models, the first version is the model trained on only task 1 and the second one is the model after training on both tasks. Therefore, there are two versions of representation space and they apply spectral decomposition on both spaces to get its eigenvalues. If the eigenvectors change significantly after training task 2, these directions are considered as forgettable directions because they cause the change in the shape of the data distribution. In figure 3.9, they compared eigenvalues before and after training with the second task using Corresponding Angles, which will be defined formally in subsection 4.4. One of the most important takeaways is that spectral components with large eigenvalues change insignificantly and thus are transferable. Based on that insight, they proposed a novel augmentation methodcalled Dual Augmentation which can enlarge the spectral components to introduce more diverse and transferable representations for incremental learning.

This study addresses the challenge of modeling structured outputs in complex systems with inherent high-order interactions. Traditional models often struggle with accurately capturing these intricate relationships, leading to suboptimal performance in tasks such as sequence prediction, image segmentation, and language translation. Methods/Approach: We propose a novel deep learning framework that enhances the architecture's ability to manage high-order interactions in structured outputs. Our approach leverages a sophisticated neural network design which integrates advanced mechanisms, including attention layers and residual connections, to effectively learn and represent complex dependencies. The model optimizes for computational efficiency, employing techniques to reduce processing overhead while maintaining high precision. Results/Findings: Experiments conducted across multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate our model's superiority over existing methods. The proposed framework achieves significant improvements in accuracy and efficiency, particularly in tasks involving large datasets with complex output structures, such as detailed image segmentation and intricate language models. Comparative analysis reveals a marked increase in performance metrics, evidencing the model's prowess in handling high-dimensional output spaces. Conclusion/Implications: This research contributes to the field of deep learning by introducing a robust model capable of effectively engaging with high-order interactions in structured outputs. The implications of this work are notable for numerous applications, ranging from autonomous systems and computational linguistics to advanced image processing domains. Our findings suggest promising directions for further exploration in optimizing deep learning architectures to tackle complex interaction scenarios more efficiently. Key Keywords: deep learning, structured outputs, high-order interaction, neural networks, attention mechanisms, image segmentation, language models.

This paper presents Neural Bellman-Ford Networks (NBFN), a novel and general graph neural network framework designed for the link prediction task. The objective of our research is to address the limitations of existing graph neural networks (GNNs) in effectively modeling complex relational patterns and long-range dependencies within large-scale graphs. Drawing inspiration from the Bellman-Ford algorithm, our approach integrates dynamic programming principles into the neural message passing process, enabling efficient aggregation of multi-hop relational information. We propose a flexible neural architecture that generalizes several existing GNN models, such as Graph Convolutional Networks and Graph Attention Networks, by incorporating learned distance-aware propagation mechanisms tailored for link prediction. Extensive experiments are conducted on both synthetic and real-world datasets, including social, citation, and knowledge graphs. Results demonstrate that Neural Bellman-Ford Networks consistently outperform state-of-the-art link prediction methods in terms of accuracy and scalability, particularly in scenarios with sparse or noisy graph structure. Furthermore, ablation studies highlight the effectiveness of our distance-aware propagation scheme in capturing essential structural features relevant to the prediction task. In conclusion, NBFN offers a unified and extensible framework for general graph representation learning, opening new possibilities for downstream applications such as recommendation systems, biological network analysis, and knowledge graph completion. Keywords: neural Bellman-Ford, graph neural networks, link prediction, message passing, graph representation, dynamic programming, multi-hop reasoning.

Image inpainting, the task of filling in missing or damaged regions of an image, remains a challenging problem in computer vision. This paper introduces a novel approach to image inpainting by leveraging frequency domain priors to guide the reconstruction process. Our method operates by analyzing the frequency spectrum of the known image regions to estimate missing frequency components corresponding to the damaged areas. We propose a new algorithm that synthesizes plausible high-frequency details based on learned statistical properties of natural images in the frequency domain. The algorithm incorporates an iterative optimization strategy to seamlessly blend the inpainted region with the surrounding context while enforcing consistency in both spatial and frequency domains. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods, producing visually compelling and structurally coherent inpaintings, particularly for images with complex textures and structures. The proposed technique offers a robust solution for various image restoration applications. Keywords: Image inpainting, Frequency domain, Image restoration, Fourier transform, Image processing, Computer vision.

This paper introduces a novel exploration strategy for reinforcement learning agents based on maximizing information gain about the environment's latent dynamics. The approach leverages a learned latent dynamics model to predict future states and quantifies uncertainty in these predictions to guide exploration. Specifically, the agent selects actions that lead to maximal reduction in its uncertainty about the latent state transitions, encouraging exploration of uncharted territories. We demonstrate that this information-maximizing exploration strategy significantly outperforms existing exploration methods, such as random exploration and curiosity-driven exploration, in a range of challenging benchmark environments. The results highlight the effectiveness of using latent dynamics models for efficient exploration and improved sample complexity. This method has implications for robotics, autonomous navigation, and other domains requiring efficient exploration in complex environments. **Keywords:** Reinforcement Learning, Exploration, Latent Dynamics Model, Information Maximization, Uncertainty, Autonomous Navigation.

Non-uniform single image deblurring remains a challenging task in computer vision due to the spatially varying nature of blur and the complexity of real-world scenes. This paper introduces a novel approach to address this problem by leveraging multi-scale deep neural networks with learned down-scaling kernels. The proposed method focuses on enhancing the quality of deblurring by incorporating adaptive down-scaling mechanisms that preserve essential image details while reducing computational complexity. Unlike traditional fixed-kernel down-scaling methods, our approach learns optimal kernels during training, enabling the network to better handle non-uniform blur patterns across different scales. The architecture integrates a multi-scale framework with attention mechanisms to prioritize regions affected by varying blur intensities. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate significant improvements in both quantitative metrics (e.g., PSNR and SSIM) and visual quality compared to state-of-the-art methods. The learned down-scaling kernels contribute to more accurate blur estimation and reconstruction, particularly in complex scenarios with motion blur and defocus. This work advances the field of image deblurring by introducing a scalable and efficient solution that adapts to non-uniform blur characteristics. The proposed method has potential applications in real-time image restoration, computational photography, and video processing, offering a robust framework for handling diverse blurring scenarios. **Keywords**: non-uniform deblurring, multi-scale deep learning, learned down-scaling kernels, image restoration, attention mechanisms.

This paper addresses the critical issue of dataset contamination in visual tracking, where noisy or irrelevant data can significantly degrade tracker performance. Our objective is to develop a robust and adaptive decontamination approach to enhance the quality of the training set, thereby improving the accuracy and reliability of discriminative visual trackers. We propose a unified formulation that integrates online learning, data cleansing, and robust optimization to effectively identify and remove contaminated data. Our method leverages a novel probabilistic framework to model data uncertainty and adaptively updates the training set to minimize the impact of noise and outliers. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art tracking methods, achieving significant improvements in tracking accuracy and robustness. The key contributions of this research include a flexible and efficient decontamination algorithm, a robust tracker formulation, and a comprehensive evaluation framework. Our work has important implications for various computer vision applications, including object tracking, surveillance, and autonomous systems, and highlights the importance of data quality and adaptability in visual tracking. Key keywords: visual tracking, dataset decontamination, robust optimization, online learning, computer vision.

Objective: This paper develops a rigorous approximation theory for convolutional neural architectures applied to time series modeling. We address the gap between practical performance of convolutional models and their theoretical understanding, focusing on how network depth, filter size, and parameter count influence approximation accuracy for temporal signals. Methods: Building on tools from harmonic analysis and functional approximation, we derive upper and lower bounds on the L2-error when representing classes of smooth and piecewise-smooth time series using 1D convolutional networks. Our analysis considers both finite-width, deep networks and architectures with residual connections. We quantify how spectral properties of the input signal and filter design affect the network’s expressivity. Results: We prove that deep convolutional networks can approximate a broad family of temporal functions with error decaying polynomially in depth and filter width, outperforming classical polynomial and Fourier methods under equivalent parameter budgets. In particular, networks with ReLU activations achieve near-optimal rates for functions with bounded variation and certain Sobolev regularity. Numerical experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets validate our theoretical bounds and demonstrate improved sample efficiency compared to recurrent and fully connected baselines. Conclusion: Our work provides the first systematic approximation-theoretic characterization of convolutional architectures for time series, offering design guidelines for depth and filter complexity. These insights pave the way toward principled architecture selection and inspire future advances in temporal deep learning. Keywords: time series modeling; convolutional neural networks; approximation theory; error bounds; spectral analysis; ReLU networks

Visual Question Answering (VQA) systems have made significant strides in recent years, yet they often struggle with tasks requiring external knowledge beyond the visual content. This paper introduces *Select, Substitute, Search (S³)*, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate the ability of VQA models to integrate external knowledge effectively. The S³ benchmark challenges models to perform three critical tasks: selecting relevant knowledge from a given context, substituting ambiguous or incomplete information with accurate external data, and searching for missing knowledge to answer complex questions. We propose a hybrid approach combining transformer-based architectures with dynamic knowledge retrieval mechanisms to address these challenges. Our experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a 12% improvement in accuracy over state-of-the-art baselines on the S³ benchmark. The results highlight the importance of robust knowledge integration in VQA systems and provide insights into the limitations of current approaches. This work contributes a new evaluation framework for knowledge-augmented VQA and advances the development of models capable of handling real-world, knowledge-intensive visual reasoning tasks. **Keywords**: Visual Question Answering, Knowledge Integration, Transformer Models, Benchmark Evaluation, Knowledge Retrieval.

This paper addresses the problem of structure estimation for discrete graphical models, a crucial task in understanding complex relationships between variables. Our objective is to develop an efficient method for estimating the structure of these models from observed data. We propose a novel approach based on generalized covariance matrices and their inverses, which enables the identification of conditional independence relationships between variables. Our method leverages the properties of these matrices to infer the underlying graph structure, outperforming existing techniques in terms of accuracy and computational efficiency. The results show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance on various benchmark datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness in recovering the true graph structure. The contributions of this research lie in its ability to handle high-dimensional data and its robustness to noise, making it a valuable tool for applications in machine learning, artificial intelligence, and data science. Key aspects of this work include graphical models, structure estimation, covariance matrices, and conditional independence, highlighting its relevance to the broader field of probabilistic graphical models and statistical learning.

Modeling và Animation Model và animation là những thứ không thể thiếu trong một game, điều này càng quan trọng hơn trong một game RPG vốn tập trung quanh một nhân vật chính. Nhờ model và animation người chơ mớ có thể biết được nhân vật họ đang điều khiển nhìn ra sao, đang trong trạng thái nào. Tuy nhên, việc tạo ra các model hay các animation đẹp, tự nhiên và uyển chuyển đồ nhỏ người thực hiện phải có chuyên môn, được qua các khóa học cụ thể cùng vớ mắt thẩm mỹ của một họa sĩ.

In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) systems have come to the forefront. These systems, mostly based on Deep learning (DL), achieve excellent results in areas such as image processing, natural language processing, or speech recognition. Despite the statistically high accuracy of deep learning models, their output is often a decision of "black box". Thus, Interpretability methods have become a popular way to gain insight into the decision-making process of deep learning models. Explanation of a deep learning model is desirable in the medical domain since the experts have to justify their judgments to the patient. In this work, we proposed a method for explanation-guided training that uses a Layer-wise relevance propagation (LRP) technique to force the model to focus only on the relevant part of the image. We experimentally verified our method on a convolutional neural network (CNN) model for low-grade and high-grade glioma classification problems. Our experiments show promising results in a way to use interpretation techniques in the model training process.

This paper presents the development of the Local Directional Order Pattern (LDOP), a novel feature descriptor designed to enhance face retrieval systems by improving robustness against variations in illumination, expression, and occlusion. The primary aim is to address the limitations of existing face retrieval approaches in terms of discriminative power and computational efficiency. Methods/Approach: LDOP leverages local directional patterns by capturing the ordinal relationship of directional edges around a pixel, thus creating a compact yet informative representation of facial features. The methodology involves encoding the directional order information into a histogram-based descriptor, which effectively preserves critical facial structure information. This approach is implemented within a retrieval framework that evaluates its performance across different datasets. Results/Findings: Experimental results demonstrate that LDOP outperforms conventional methods such as Local Binary Patterns (LBP) and Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) in terms of retrieval accuracy and robustness. Comparative analysis on benchmark face datasets shows that LDOP consistently achieves superior performance, highlighting its ability to maintain discrimination under challenging conditions, including varying poses and partial occlusions. Conclusion/Implications: The introduction of LDOP significantly contributes to the field of face retrieval by offering a robust and efficient descriptor that can be utilized in numerous applications, including security systems, biometrics, and digital forensics. Its enhanced performance in diverse scenarios suggests potential applications in real-time systems where both accuracy and speed are crucial. This advancement opens avenues for further research into the integration of LDOP with machine learning algorithms to optimize face recognition processes. Keywords: LDOP, face retrieval, local directional patterns, feature descriptor, image processing, facial recognition.

Nghiên cứu này tập trung vào việc phát triển bộ điều khiển học lặp cho hệ thống tạo vi giọt chất lỏng, nhằm nâng cao hiệu suất và độ chính xác trong quá trình sản xuất vi giọt. Hệ thống này có ứng dụng rộng rãi trong nhiều lĩnh vực như y học, công nghệ sinh học và hóa học, nơi mà việc kiểm soát kích thước và số lượng vi giọt là rất quan trọng. Qua việc áp dụng các thuật toán học máy, bộ điều khiển được thiết kế để tự động điều chỉnh các thông số hoạt động, từ đó tối ưu hóa quy trình tạo ra vi giọt theo yêu cầu cụ thể. Kết quả thử nghiệm cho thấy bộ điều khiển này không chỉ cải thiện đáng kể độ chính xác trong việc tạo ra vi giọt mà còn giảm thiểu thời gian và chi phí sản xuất. Nghiên cứu mở ra hướng đi mới cho việc ứng dụng công nghệ điều khiển thông minh trong sản xuất vi giọt, góp phần thúc đẩy sự phát triển của các ngành công nghiệp liên quan.

Dữ lệu cho một mục trong phần Phân tích danh mục (phân tích lịch sử giao dịch của người dùng) đồ hỏ sự kết nối giữa các bảng trong truy vấn sao cho hợp lý và đáp ứng về yêu cầu phi chức năng là thờ gan phản hồi, ví dụ như mục Cơ bản dưới đây Hình 5.1: Tab cơ bản trong Danh mục của tô Để có thể tính được sự tăng trưởng về doanh thu hay lợi nhuận cần truy vấn dữ lệu báo cáo tài chính của hag quý gần nhất, trong trường hợp doanh nghiệp đó không có dữ lệu phải dùng bản ghi tương tự khác, vì có hai loại dữ lệu doanh thu/lợi nhuận mà doanh nghiệp gh lạ.

Các chỉ số nhân trắc học đóng vai trò quan trọng trong việc ước tính phần trăm mỡ cơ thể ở trẻ em và vị thành niên tại Quận 10, Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh. Nghiên cứu này tập trung vào việc phân tích các yếu tố như chiều cao, cân nặng, chỉ số khối cơ thể (BMI), và tỷ lệ vòng eo/vòng hông để đánh giá tình trạng dinh dưỡng và sức khỏe của nhóm đối tượng này. Kết quả cho thấy, các chỉ số nhân trắc học có mối tương quan chặt chẽ với tỷ lệ mỡ cơ thể, giúp xác định nguy cơ thừa cân, béo phì hoặc suy dinh dưỡng. Điều này cung cấp cơ sở khoa học để xây dựng các chương trình can thiệp dinh dưỡng và nâng cao sức khỏe cộng đồng, đặc biệt là ở lứa tuổi đang phát triển.

Nghiên cứu về chủng nấm dược liệu Cordyceps militaris bạch tạng (albino) đã làm sáng tỏ một số đặc điểm sinh học quan trọng. Chủng nấm này, với màu sắc khác biệt so với các chủng thông thường, được phân lập và nuôi cấy thành công trong môi trường nhân tạo. Các thí nghiệm đã chỉ ra rằng chủng bạch tạng này có tốc độ sinh trưởng và phát triển tương đương, thậm chí có phần vượt trội so với các chủng Cordyceps militaris khác. Bên cạnh đó, thành phần hóa học và dược tính của chủng bạch tạng cũng được phân tích, cho thấy tiềm năng ứng dụng lớn trong lĩnh vực y học và thực phẩm chức năng. Nghiên cứu này mở ra hướng đi mới trong việc khai thác và phát triển các chủng nấm dược liệu quý hiếm, góp phần đa dạng hóa nguồn nguyên liệu cho ngành công nghiệp dược phẩm. Việc hiểu rõ đặc điểm sinh học của chủng nấm bạch tạng này là tiền đề quan trọng cho các nghiên cứu sâu hơn về cơ chế tác dụng và ứng dụng lâm sàng trong tương lai.

This paper introduces Learning Subspace Minimization (LSM), a novel framework for low-level vision tasks. The objective is to enhance performance in tasks like image denoising, super-resolution, and inpainting by learning an optimal subspace for representing local image patches. Unlike traditional methods that rely on fixed or hand-crafted subspaces, LSM adaptively learns a task-specific subspace directly from training data via a deep neural network. The proposed network architecture incorporates a minimization module that explicitly encourages the learned representations to lie within the identified subspace. This module is trained end-to-end with the rest of the network, enabling effective optimization of the subspace for the target task. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate that LSM achieves state-of-the-art performance in image denoising, super-resolution, and inpainting, outperforming existing methods in terms of PSNR and SSIM. The learned subspaces are shown to be more robust and efficient than generic handcrafted bases, offering a promising direction for improving low-level vision algorithms. Keywords: low-level vision, subspace learning, image denoising, super-resolution, inpainting, deep learning.

Nghiên cứu này tập trung vào việc đánh giá đặc tính và ứng dụng của eco-enzyme được chiết xuất từ vỏ quả họ Citrus trong quá trình làm sạch. Eco-enzyme, một sản phẩm sinh học tự nhiên, được sản xuất thông qua quá trình lên men các nguyên liệu hữu cơ, cho thấy tiềm năng lớn trong việc thay thế các hóa chất tẩy rửa độc hại. Các thí nghiệm đã chỉ ra rằng eco-enzyme từ vỏ quả họ Citrus không chỉ có khả năng làm sạch hiệu quả mà còn an toàn cho sức khỏe con người và môi trường. Bên cạnh đó, nghiên cứu cũng phân tích các yếu tố ảnh hưởng đến hiệu suất làm sạch của eco-enzyme, từ đó đề xuất các phương pháp tối ưu hóa quy trình sản xuất. Kết quả cho thấy eco-enzyme có thể được ứng dụng rộng rãi trong các lĩnh vực như gia đình, công nghiệp và nông nghiệp, góp phần vào việc phát triển bền vững và bảo vệ môi trường.

Xác định loại nấm mốc và vi khuẩn gây bệnh sau thu hoạch trên vải là một vấn đề quan trọng trong lĩnh vực nông nghiệp. Nấm mốc và vi khuẩn có thể gây ra các bệnh nghiêm trọng cho cây trồng, dẫn đến giảm sản lượng và chất lượng nông sản. Các loại nấm mốc phổ biến gây bệnh trên vải bao gồm Fusarium, Aspergillus và Penicillium. Chúng có thể gây ra các bệnh như Fusarium wilt, Aspergillus ear rot và Penicillium ear rot. Trong khi đó, các loại vi khuẩn như Pseudomonas và Xanthomonas cũng có thể gây ra các bệnh như bacterial leaf spot và bacterial fruit rot. Để xác định loại nấm mốc và vi khuẩn gây bệnh, cần thực hiện các phương pháp phân tích như PCR (Polymerase Chain Reaction), Sanger sequencing và MALDI-TOF (Matrix-Assisted Laser Desorption/Ionization-Time of Flight). Các phương pháp này giúp xác định chính xác loại nấm mốc và vi khuẩn gây bệnh. Phương pháp phòng trừ nấm mốc và vi khuẩn bao gồm sử dụng các hóa chất bảo vệ thực vật, thực hành nông nghiệp tốt, và sử dụng các phương pháp sinh học như sử dụng vi khuẩn đối kháng. Ngoài ra, cần thực hiện các biện pháp phòng ngừa như bảo quản nông sản đúng cách, tránh sử dụng nước quá nhiều, và sử dụng các loại vải có khả năng chống nấm mốc cao.

Áp xe gan ở trẻ em là một tình trạng nghiêm trọng, thường gây ra bởi nhiễm trùng hoặc vi khuẩn. Tại Bệnh viện Nhi đồng 2, nghiên cứu đã chỉ ra rằng các triệu chứng lâm sàng của bệnh thường bao gồm sốt, đau bụng, và mệt mỏi. Các phương pháp cận lâm sàng như siêu âm và chụp CT đóng vai trò quan trọng trong việc chẩn đoán và xác định vị trí của áp xe. Kết quả điều trị cho thấy, việc can thiệp sớm và sử dụng kháng sinh thích hợp giúp cải thiện tình trạng bệnh nhân đáng kể. Hầu hết trẻ em được điều trị thành công và hồi phục tốt, tuy nhiên, vẫn cần theo dõi lâu dài để phát hiện các biến chứng có thể xảy ra. Nghiên cứu này nhấn mạnh tầm quan trọng của việc nhận diện sớm và điều trị kịp thời để giảm thiểu nguy cơ và cải thiện sức khỏe cho trẻ em mắc bệnh.

With Docker, applications can be deployed quickly and efficiently, reducing de ployment time and resource consumption. Containers are isolated from the host system and from other containers, enhancing security and enabling microservices architecture. Docker also facilitates horizontal scaling, allowing applications to be easily replicated across multiple containers to handle increased demand.

Nghiên cứu đánh giá khả năng chịu mặn của cá trắm đen giống, một loài cá nước ngọt có giá trị kinh tế cao, trước bối cảnh xâm nhập mặn ngày càng gia tăng. Thí nghiệm được thực hiện bằng cách cho cá tiếp xúc với các mức độ mặn khác nhau trong môi trường kiểm soát. Kết quả cho thấy cá trắm đen giống có thể chịu được độ mặn nhất định, tuy nhiên khả năng này giảm dần khi độ mặn tăng cao. Các chỉ số sinh lý, tập tính của cá cũng bị ảnh hưởng đáng kể bởi độ mặn. Nghiên cứu này cung cấp thông tin quan trọng cho việc lựa chọn vùng nuôi phù hợp, phát triển kỹ thuật nuôi thích ứng với biến đổi khí hậu, đồng thời góp phần bảo tồn và phát triển bền vững nghề nuôi cá trắm đen. Cần có thêm các nghiên cứu sâu hơn để hiểu rõ cơ chế chịu mặn của cá và tìm ra các biện pháp nâng cao khả năng này.

This paper presents a novel approach to image caption generation, enabling fine-grained control over the output captions through the utilization of abstract scene graphs. The objective is to address the limitation of existing image captioning models, which often lack the flexibility to incorporate user preferences or specific requirements. Our method employs a graph-based representation of the scene, allowing for the explicit specification of desired caption content and structure. We propose a multimodal framework that integrates visual features, scene graphs, and natural language processing to generate captions that align with user-provided abstract scene graphs. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in producing high-quality, user-controlled captions, outperforming state-of-the-art models in terms of accuracy, fluency, and relevance. The key contributions of this research include the introduction of abstract scene graphs as a means of controlling image caption generation and the development of a novel graph-based captioning model. This work has significant implications for applications such as image description generation, visual question answering, and human-computer interaction, particularly in areas where fine-grained control over output is crucial. Key keywords: image caption generation, abstract scene graphs, fine-grained control, multimodal learning, natural language processing.

Salient object detection is a critical aspect of computer vision, aiming to identify the most conspicuous objects in a scene. Traditional methods often rely on predefined thresholds, which can compromise accuracy and applicability. This study proposes a new approach to optimize the F-measure for threshold-free salient object detection, effectively addressing these limitations. Methods: We introduce a novel algorithm that eliminates the dependency on manual thresholding by leveraging advanced machine learning techniques. Our approach involves a dynamic threshold optimization process, which automatically adjusts to varying scene complexities and object characteristics. This is achieved through a combination of deep learning architectures and reinforcement learning strategies, allowing for adaptive saliency prediction. Results: The proposed method demonstrates significant improvements in F-measure scores compared to existing threshold-based techniques. Our model was extensively evaluated on multiple benchmark datasets, showing superior performance in terms of precision, recall, and overall detection accuracy. Additionally, our approach is computationally efficient, making it suitable for real-time applications. Conclusion: The research presents a substantial advancement in the field of salient object detection, offering a robust threshold-free solution that enhances both accuracy and efficiency. The implications of this work extend to various applications, including image processing, object recognition, and automated vision systems. By optimizing the F-measure without the constraints of manual thresholding, the proposed method sets a new standard for future research and development in object detection technologies. Keywords: F-measure, threshold-free, salient object detection, machine learning, deep learning, adaptive saliency, computer vision.

Sodium humate và sodium lignosulfonate là hai chất phụ gia quan trọng được nghiên cứu nhằm cải thiện tính dẻo của phối liệu trong quá trình in 3D sản xuất sứ. Các thí nghiệm cho thấy, việc bổ sung hai hợp chất này giúp tăng độ nhớt và độ đàn hồi của hỗn hợp, từ đó nâng cao khả năng định hình và độ chính xác của sản phẩm. Sodium humate có khả năng tương tác tốt với các hạt sứ, tạo ra cấu trúc mạng lưới bền vững, trong khi sodium lignosulfonate đóng vai trò như chất phân tán, giảm thiểu hiện tượng vón cục. Kết quả nghiên cứu mở ra hướng ứng dụng tiềm năng trong công nghệ in 3D, đặc biệt là trong lĩnh vực sản xuất sứ cao cấp, nơi yêu cầu độ chính xác và tính thẩm mỹ cao.

Các nghiên cứu đi từ đơn giản là bức ảnh chỉ có một vật, rồi một vật với số lượng nhiều trong một ảnh, và sau đó là nhiều vật trong cùng một bức ảnh. Bên cạnh việc nhận diện, phát hiện được vị trí của vật thể, một công việc khó khăn hơn chính là làm sao để xác định được ch tết của từng đối tượng đến từng điểm ảnh trong bức ảnh. Cùng với sự chính xác trong việc nhận diện chính là tốc độ cần đủ điểm nhận diện vật thể trong thờ gan thực đáp ứng nhu cầu thực tiễn cần thiết cho con người.

Sự suy giảm tài nguyên biển hiện nay đang trở thành một vấn đề nghiêm trọng trên toàn thế giới. Nguyên nhân chính dẫn đến tình trạng này bao gồm sự tăng trưởng nhanh chóng của dân số, hoạt động khai thác tài nguyên biển quá mức, và sự thay đổi khí hậu. Tài nguyên biển là nguồn cung cấp đa dạng và quan trọng cho sự phát triển kinh tế và xã hội của con người. Tuy nhiên, sự suy giảm tài nguyên biển không chỉ ảnh hưởng đến môi trường mà còn tác động tiêu cực đến cuộc sống của con người. Để giải quyết vấn đề này, cần có các giải pháp tích cực và bền vững. De Bruijn graphs have become integral to various modern applications in biology, playing a crucial role in genome assembly processes. Tools such as EULER-USR and innovative techniques developed by Pevzner and colleagues have significantly advanced the field by addressing and resolving one of the chief challenges—repeats in DNA fragment assembly. These methods enable efficient and accurate reconstruction of entire genomes from fragmented sequencing data, which is often complicated by recurring DNA sequences. The utility of De Bruijn graphs extends beyond assembly, having been adapted for global DNA sequence alignment, thereby improving our ability to compare extensive complex sequences. Additionally, these graph-based approaches form the backbone of several recent studies into DNA storage, underscoring their continued relevance and versatility in computational biology.

This paper introduces Bi-GCN, a novel binary graph convolutional network designed to efficiently process graph-structured data. The objective is to reduce the computational complexity and memory requirements of traditional graph convolutional networks (GCNs) while maintaining their expressive power. To achieve this, we propose a binary representation of graph convolutions, leveraging binary weights and activations to simplify the network architecture. Our approach utilizes a binary approximation of the convolutional operation, enabling significant reductions in computational cost and model size. Experimental results demonstrate that Bi-GCN achieves comparable performance to state-of-the-art GCNs on benchmark datasets, while requiring substantially fewer parameters and computations. The key contributions of this work include the development of a binary graph convolutional layer, a novel binary activation function, and a highly efficient training procedure. Bi-GCN has significant implications for real-world applications, including graph classification, node classification, and graph generation, particularly in resource-constrained environments. Key keywords: graph neural networks, binary neural networks, graph convolutional networks, efficient deep learning, binary graph representation.

The increasing deployment of machine learning models in critical applications necessitates trustworthy explanations for their decisions. While empirical explainers, such as SHAP and LIME, offer model-agnostic explanation methods, they often suffer from computational inefficiency, limiting their applicability to complex models and large datasets. This paper introduces a novel framework for generating efficient explanations from empirical explainers, focusing on reducing the computational overhead without sacrificing explanation fidelity. Our approach leverages a combination of instance selection techniques, dimensionality reduction, and optimized sampling strategies to accelerate the explanation process. We evaluate our framework on several benchmark datasets and demonstrate significant speedups compared to traditional empirical explainers, achieving up to a 5x reduction in computation time while maintaining comparable explanation accuracy as measured by established fidelity metrics. Furthermore, we analyze the trade-offs between efficiency and accuracy, providing guidelines for selecting appropriate parameters based on specific application requirements. Our findings contribute to the practical deployment of explainable AI by enabling the efficient generation of explanations for complex models in resource-constrained environments. Keywords: Explainable AI, Empirical Explainers, SHAP, LIME, Efficiency, Instance Selection, Dimensionality Reduction, Model Explanation.

Deep learning is a kind of feature learning method with strong nonliear feature transformation and becomes more and more important in many fields of artificial intelligence. Deep autoencoder is one representative method of the deep learning methods, and can effectively extract abstract the information of datasets. However, it does not consider the complementarity between the deep features and original features during deep feature transformation. Besides, it suffers from small sample problem. In order to solve these problems, a novel deep autoencoder - hybrid feature embedded stacked sparse autoencoder(HESSAE) has been proposed in this paper. HFESAE is capable to learn discriminant deep features with the help of embedding original features to filter weak hidden-layer outputs during training. For the issue that class representation ability of abstract information is limited by small sample problem, a feature fusion strategy has been designed aiming to combining abstract information learned by HFESAE with original feature and obtain hybrid features for feature reduction. The strategy is hybrid feature selection strategy based on L1 regularization followed by an support vector machine(SVM) ensemble model, in which weighted local discriminant preservation projection (w_LPPD), is designed and employed on each base classifier. At the end of this paper, several representative public datasets are used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm. The experimental results demonstrated that, the proposed feature learning method yields superior performance compared to other existing and state of art feature learning algorithms including some representative deep autoencoder methods.

This paper addresses the challenge of learning latent representations that can effectively predict future events in dynamic systems, a critical task for applications such as autonomous decision-making and predictive modeling. We propose a novel framework, *Latent Event-Predictive Encodings through Counterfactual Regularization* (LEPECR), which leverages counterfactual reasoning to enhance the robustness and generalization of event-predictive models. Unlike traditional approaches that rely solely on observed data, LEPECR introduces a regularization mechanism that encourages the latent space to encode not only the most likely future events but also plausible alternative scenarios. This is achieved by minimizing the divergence between the latent representations of factual and counterfactual trajectories, ensuring the model remains sensitive to potential variations in event sequences. We evaluate LEPECR on synthetic and real-world datasets, demonstrating its superior performance in predicting complex event sequences compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Our results show that the proposed method achieves higher accuracy and robustness, particularly in scenarios with sparse or noisy data. The implications of this work extend to domains such as robotics, healthcare, and financial forecasting, where reliable event prediction is crucial. By integrating counterfactual reasoning into latent representation learning, LEPECR offers a significant step forward in developing more interpretable and generalizable predictive models. **Keywords**: latent representations, event prediction, counterfactual reasoning, regularization, predictive modeling, dynamic systems.

Despite the intense attention and investment into clinical machine learning (CML) research, relatively few applications convert to clinical practice. While research is important in advancing the state-of-the-art, translation is equally important in bringing these technologies into a position to ultimately impact patient care and live up to extensive expectations surrounding AI in healthcare. To better characterize a holistic perspective among researchers and practitioners, we survey several participants with experience in developing CML for clinical deployment about their learned experiences. This paper explores the integration of causality into machine learning frameworks, addressing the critical challenge of distinguishing between correlation and causation in complex datasets. Our approach leverages causal graph structures and do-calculus to develop a novel algorithm that can identify and quantify causal relationships. We apply this method to various domains, including healthcare and finance, demonstrating its ability to improve model interpretability and predictive accuracy. The results show significant enhancements in model performance, particularly in scenarios where causal insights are crucial. Our research contributes to the development of more reliable and transparent machine learning models, with potential applications in high-stakes decision-making. By emphasizing causality, we provide a foundation for more accurate and informative AI systems, highlighting the importance of causal machine learning in real-world problem-solving. Key aspects of this work include causal discovery, causal inference, and explainable AI, offering a unique perspective on the intersection of machine learning and causality.

This paper presents a comprehensive survey on semi-supervised learning techniques for handling delayed partially labelled data streams. The objective is to address the challenge of processing continuous data flows where labels are partially available and often delayed, which hinders the performance of traditional supervised learning methods. We employ a systematic approach to review existing semi-supervised learning models, including self-training, co-training, and graph-based methods, and examine their suitability for delayed partially labelled data streams. Our analysis reveals that combining active learning strategies with semi-supervised techniques can effectively leverage limited labelled data and improve model performance. The results show that the proposed framework outperforms traditional supervised learning methods in terms of accuracy and robustness. This research contributes to the development of more efficient and adaptive machine learning systems for real-world applications, such as sensor networks, financial transactions, and social media analytics, where data streams are often partially labelled and delayed. Key contributions include the identification of novel semi-supervised learning techniques, the evaluation of their performance on delayed partially labelled data streams, and the discussion of future research directions. Relevant keywords: semi-supervised learning, delayed partially labelled data streams, active learning, machine learning, data streams, adaptive systems.

This paper introduces a novel methodology for extracting fashion trends from social media images by leveraging object detection and unsupervised learning techniques. The primary objective is to develop a robust and automated system capable of identifying emerging fashion items and styles from the vast visual data available on platforms like Instagram and Pinterest. Our approach employs a state-of-the-art object detection model, fine-tuned for recognizing clothing items and accessories, followed by an unsupervised clustering algorithm to group visually similar detections and identify prevalent trends. Specifically, we utilize a YOLOv5-based detector, pre-trained on a large fashion dataset and further refined with a novel self-training strategy to improve accuracy on noisy social media data. The clustered detections are then analyzed to extract key visual features characterizing each trend. Experimental results demonstrate the system's ability to effectively identify trending items with an average precision of 85% and accurately categorize them based on visual similarity. This approach provides a scalable and automated solution for fashion trend forecasting, offering valuable insights for designers, retailers, and consumers. Keywords: Fashion trends, object detection, unsupervised learning, social media, computer vision, YOLOv5.

This paper focuses on inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) for autonomous robot navigation using semantic observations. The objective is to infer a cost function that explains demonstrated behavior while relying only on the expert's observations and state-control trajectory. We develop a map encoder, which infers semantic class probabilities from the observation sequence, and a cost encoder, defined as deep neural network over the semantic features. Since the expert cost is not directly observable, the representation parameters can only be optimized by differentiating the error between demonstrated controls and a control policy computed from the cost estimate. The error is optimized using a closed-form subgradient computed only over a subset of promising states via a motion planning algorithm. We show that our approach learns to follow traffic rules in the autonomous driving CARLA simulator by relying on semantic observations of cars, sidewalks and road lanes.

Dự đoán co ngót bê tông tuổi sớm là một vấn đề quan trọng trong xây dựng, giúp đảm bảo chất lượng và độ bền của công trình. Nhiệt độ và độ ẩm bên trong là hai yếu tố chính ảnh hưởng đến quá trình co ngót bê tông. Khi nhiệt độ tăng, bê tông sẽ co ngót nhanh hơn, trong khi độ ẩm cao có thể làm chậm quá trình co ngót. Các nghiên cứu gần đây đã chỉ ra rằng, nhiệt độ và độ ẩm bên trong có thể dự đoán được độ co ngót của bê tông tuổi sớm. Với nhiệt độ cao, bê tông có thể co ngót từ 1-2% trong 28 ngày, trong khi với độ ẩm cao, độ co ngót có thể giảm xuống còn 0,5-1%. Điều này cho thấy rằng, việc kiểm soát nhiệt độ và độ ẩm bên trong có thể giúp giảm thiểu độ co ngót của bê tông tuổi sớm. Dự đoán co ngót bê tông tuổi sớm dựa trên nhiệt độ và độ ẩm bên trong có thể giúp các nhà xây dựng và kỹ sư dự đoán và phòng ngừa các vấn đề liên quan đến co ngót bê tông. Điều này có thể giúp đảm bảo chất lượng và độ bền của công trình, đồng thời giảm thiểu chi phí và thời gian sửa chữa.

This paper introduces a novel approach to text generation using implicit deep latent variable models (IDLVMs). Addressing limitations in traditional latent variable models, which often suffer from posterior collapse and lack of explicit control over generated text, our method leverages implicit variational inference to learn a more informative and disentangled latent space. The IDLVM incorporates a deep neural network to map the latent variables to the text space, enabling the generation of diverse and coherent text. We employ a novel training objective that combines adversarial training with a reconstruction loss, encouraging the model to learn a latent space that captures meaningful semantic information. Experiments on several benchmark text generation datasets demonstrate that our IDLVM significantly outperforms existing latent variable models in terms of text quality, diversity, and controllability. Specifically, the generated text exhibits improved fluency and relevance to the input latent code. The results highlight the potential of implicit deep latent variable models for high-quality text generation and controllable text synthesis. Keywords: text generation, latent variable models, variational inference, implicit models, deep learning.

This paper explores the tradeoff between spatial and temporal aspects in video super-resolution, a crucial problem in computer vision. Our objective is to investigate the balance between enhancing spatial details and preserving temporal consistency in video frames. We propose a novel approach that utilizes a deep learning-based framework, incorporating both spatial and temporal modules to achieve high-quality video super-resolution. Our method leverages a spatial attention mechanism to focus on detailed regions and a temporal module to maintain coherence across frames. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of spatial resolution and temporal stability. Our findings suggest that there is indeed a tradeoff between spatial and temporal aspects, and optimizing for one aspect can compromise the other. We conclude that a balanced approach, considering both spatial and temporal factors, is essential for achieving optimal video super-resolution performance. This research contributes to the development of more efficient and effective video super-resolution algorithms, with potential applications in video surveillance, entertainment, and virtual reality. Key keywords: video super-resolution, spatial-temporal tradeoff, deep learning, computer vision.

This paper addresses the challenge of simultaneously performing object detection and pose estimation, a key task in computer vision, by leveraging the capabilities of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). The study aims to evaluate and compare the effectiveness of different CNN architectures in achieving high accuracy in these dual tasks. Methods/Approach: We examine several state-of-the-art CNN models, implementing a joint learning framework that encapsulates object detection and pose estimation within a unified network. The architectures under consideration include variations in depth, complexity, and feature extraction techniques, allowing for a comprehensive analysis. The study also incorporates data augmentation and transfer learning to enhance model performance. Results/Findings: The experimental results demonstrate that certain CNN architectures significantly outperform others in jointly detecting and estimating object poses with high precision. Comparative analysis reveals that models with enhanced feature extraction capabilities exhibit superior performance, showing improved accuracy and robustness in diverse and complex scenarios. Key metrics, including detection accuracy and pose estimation error, are used to benchmark the models. Conclusion/Implications: This comparative study contributes valuable insights into the suitability of different CNN architectures for the task of joint object detection and pose estimation. The findings suggest that integrating efficient feature extraction techniques is critical to enhancing the network's overall performance. The study lays the groundwork for further research into optimized CNN models, with potential applications spanning robotics, augmented reality, and autonomous systems. Keywords: Convolutional Neural Networks, object detection, pose estimation, computer vision, joint learning, deep learning, model comparison.

This paper explores the development of agents with distinct behaviors, namely prosocial and selfish, for contract negotiation using reinforcement learning. The objective is to investigate how different behavioral models impact negotiation outcomes and relationships between agents. We employ a reinforcement learning approach, utilizing Q-learning and Deep Q-Networks, to train agents with prosocial and selfish tendencies. Our results show that prosocial agents achieve higher joint utilities and more cooperative relationships, while selfish agents prioritize individual gains. The findings have significant implications for the design of autonomous negotiation systems, highlighting the importance of considering agent behavior and its impact on negotiation outcomes. This research contributes to the field of artificial intelligence and multi-agent systems, with potential applications in e-commerce, supply chain management, and conflict resolution. Key keywords: reinforcement learning, contract negotiation, prosocial behavior, selfish behavior, multi-agent systems, autonomous negotiation.

This paper investigates the training of Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs) using word observations, aiming to enhance the modeling of textual data for natural language processing applications. Traditional RBMs, widely used for unsupervised feature learning, typically operate on binary or real-valued input data, which limits their direct applicability to text, where observations are word occurrences or counts. To address this limitation, we propose a modified RBM framework capable of effectively representing discrete word data by adjusting the energy function and sampling procedures to accommodate categorical inputs. We describe the mathematical formulation and training methodology, including an adaptation of contrastive divergence for word-based datasets. Experimental results on benchmark text corpora demonstrate that our word-based RBM significantly improves the quality of learned word representations and document clustering performance compared to standard binary RBMs. The findings highlight the model’s ability to capture semantic relationships and latent structures within text. This work contributes a novel approach for leveraging RBMs in natural language processing tasks, opening possibilities for more effective unsupervised learning on large-scale textual data. Keywords: Restricted Boltzmann Machine, word observations, text modeling, natural language processing, unsupervised learning, document representation.

In this paper, we propose a novel layer based on fast Walsh-Hadamard transform (WHT) and smooth-thresholding to replace 1\times 1 convolution layers in deep neural networks. In the WHT domain, we denoise the transform domain coefficients using the new smooth-thresholding non-linearity, a smoothed version of the well-known soft-thresholding operator. We also introduce a family of multiplication-free operators from the basic 2\times2 Hadamard transform to implement 3\times 3 depthwise separable convolution layers. Using these two types of layers, we replace the bottleneck layers in MobileNet-V2 to reduce the network's number of parameters with a slight loss in accuracy. For example, by replacing the final third bottleneck layers, we reduce the number of parameters from 2.270M to 540K. This reduces the accuracy from 95.21\% to 92.98\% on the CIFAR-10 dataset. Our approach significantly improves the speed of data processing. The fast Walsh-Hadamard transform has a computational complexity of O(m\log_2 m). As a result, it is computationally more efficient than the 1\times1 convolution layer. The fast Walsh-Hadamard layer processes a tensor in \mathbb^ about 2 times faster than 1\times1 convolution layer on NVIDIA Jetson Nano computer board.

LiDAR data is becoming increasingly essential with the rise of autonomous vehicles. Its ability to provide 360deg horizontal field of view of point cloud, equips self-driving vehicles with enhanced situational awareness capabilities. While synthetic LiDAR data generation pipelines provide a good solution to advance the machine learning research on LiDAR, they do suffer from a major shortcoming, which is rendering time. Physically accurate LiDAR simulators (e.g. Blensor) are computationally expensive with an average rendering time of 14-60 seconds per frame for urban scenes. This is often compensated for via using 3D models with simplified polygon topology (low poly assets) as is the case of CARLA (Dosovitskiy et al., 2017). However, this comes at the price of having coarse grained unrealistic LiDAR point clouds. In this paper, we present a novel method to simulate LiDAR point cloud with faster rendering time of 1 sec per frame. The proposed method relies on spherical UV unwrapping of Equirectangular Z-Buffer images. We chose Blensor (Gschwandtner et al., 2011) as the baseline method to compare the point clouds generated using the proposed method. The reported error for complex urban landscapes is 4.28cm for a scanning range between 2-120 meters with Velodyne HDL64-E2 parameters. The proposed method reported a total time per frame to 3.2 +/- 0.31 seconds per frame. In contrast, the BlenSor baseline method reported 16.2 +/- 1.82 seconds.

This paper introduces a novel approach to geodesic regression, focusing on computational efficiency and predictive accuracy. Traditional geodesic regression methods, while effective, often suffer from high computational costs, particularly when dealing with large datasets or complex manifolds. To address this, we propose Fast Predictive Simple Geodesic Regression (FPSGR), a method that leverages a simplified geodesic model coupled with a fast prediction strategy. FPSGR approximates geodesics using a streamlined iterative process, significantly reducing the computational burden. Furthermore, it incorporates a predictive framework that allows for efficient estimation of geodesic paths for new data points. Our experiments, conducted on both synthetic and real-world datasets, demonstrate that FPSGR achieves comparable or superior predictive performance to existing geodesic regression techniques, while offering a substantial reduction in computation time. Specifically, FPSGR shows a speedup of up to an order of magnitude in certain scenarios. These results highlight the potential of FPSGR for applications requiring fast and accurate geodesic regression, such as shape analysis, medical image analysis, and machine learning on manifolds. Key words: Geodesic Regression, Manifolds, Shape Analysis, Predictive Modeling, Computational Efficiency.

Việc kết hợp hài hòa giữa kiến trúc đô thị và cảnh quan nông nghiệp sẽ tạo ra một không gian sống lý tưởng, thu hút du khách và góp phần vào sự phát triển kinh tế - xã hội của thành phố. Bên cạnh đó, cần có chính sách hỗ trợ và khuyến khích phù hợp để thúc đẩy các hoạt động nông nghiệp bền vững và bảo vệ môi trường.

This paper introduces a novel end-to-end Optical Character Recognition (OCR) approach specifically designed for ultra-low-resolution printed text images, a domain where traditional OCR methods often fail. Our approach leverages a deep convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture, trained directly on low-resolution images without requiring pre-processing steps such as image enhancement or binarization. The model integrates feature extraction and sequence modeling into a single trainable framework, enabling it to learn robust representations directly from the degraded input data. Experimental results on a newly created dataset of ultra-low-resolution text demonstrate a significant improvement in character recognition accuracy compared to state-of-the-art OCR engines and conventional image processing techniques. The proposed method achieves a character accuracy rate of X%, representing a Y% improvement over the next best approach. This end-to-end learning paradigm offers a promising solution for reading text in challenging scenarios where image quality is severely limited, with potential applications in document analysis, historical text digitization, and resource-constrained devices. Keywords: Optical Character Recognition, OCR, Low-Resolution Images, Deep Learning, Convolutional Neural Network, End-to-End Learning, Text Recognition.

Nghiên cứu này tập trung vào việc dự đoán hành vi uốn của các dầm thép bị ăn mòn theo thời gian một cách nhân tạo. Các dầm thép là một phần quan trọng trong xây dựng, nhưng sự ăn mòn có thể làm giảm đáng kể khả năng chịu lực và tuổi thọ của chúng. Thông qua các mô hình phân tích và thử nghiệm, nghiên cứu đã chỉ ra rằng mức độ ăn mòn và thời gian tiếp xúc với môi trường có ảnh hưởng lớn đến khả năng chịu uốn của dầm. Kết quả cho thấy việc dự đoán chính xác hành vi uốn của dầm thép bị ăn mòn có thể giúp các kỹ sư thiết kế và bảo trì công trình hiệu quả hơn, từ đó nâng cao độ an toàn và giảm thiểu rủi ro trong xây dựng. Nghiên cứu cũng nhấn mạnh tầm quan trọng của việc theo dõi và đánh giá tình trạng của các kết cấu thép trong suốt quá trình sử dụng.

Nghiên cứu đánh giá khả năng tiêu hóa biểu kiến dưỡng chất của khẩu phần sử dụng bột cá biển và bột cá tra ở gà cho thấy sự khác biệt đáng kể về hiệu quả dinh dưỡng giữa hai nguồn nguyên liệu này. Bột cá biển, với hàm lượng đạm cao và cân đối axit amin, giúp gà hấp thu dưỡng chất tốt hơn, cải thiện tỷ lệ chuyển hóa thức ăn. Trong khi đó, bột cá tra cũng mang lại hiệu quả nhất định nhưng thấp hơn so với bột cá biển do thành phần dinh dưỡng không đồng đều. Kết quả nghiên cứu này góp phần cung cấp cơ sở khoa học để lựa chọn nguyên liệu phù hợp, tối ưu hóa khẩu phần ăn cho gà, nhằm nâng cao năng suất và chất lượng sản phẩm chăn nuôi.

World Health Organization (WHO) provides the guideline for managing the Particulate Matter (PM) level because when the PM level is higher, it threats the human health. For managing PM level, the procedure for measuring PM value is needed firstly. We use Tapered Element Oscillating Microbalance (TEOM)-based PM measuring sensors because it shows higher cost-effectiveness than Beta Attenuation Monitor (BAM)-based sensor. However, TEOM-based sensor has higher probability of malfunctioning than BAM-based sensor. In this paper, we call the overall malfunction as an anomaly, and we aim to detect anomalies for the maintenance of PM measuring sensors. We propose a novel architecture for solving the above aim that named as Hypothesis Pruning Generative Adversarial Network (HP-GAN). We experimentally compare the several anomaly detection architectures to certify ours performing better.

Thanh Hóa đặt mục tiêu nâng cao hiệu quả xúc tiến đầu tư đến năm 2025, tầm nhìn 2030 thông qua các giải pháp đồng bộ và toàn diện. Tỉnh tập trung vào việc cải thiện môi trường đầu tư kinh doanh, đơn giản hóa thủ tục hành chính, tăng cường đối thoại với doanh nghiệp và nhà đầu tư. Đồng thời, Thanh Hóa chú trọng xây dựng cơ sở hạ tầng đồng bộ, đặc biệt là hạ tầng giao thông, khu công nghiệp, cụm công nghiệp, tạo điều kiện thuận lợi cho hoạt động sản xuất kinh doanh. Tỉnh cũng đẩy mạnh quảng bá tiềm năng, lợi thế cạnh tranh, các chính sách ưu đãi đầu tư hấp dẫn, thu hút đầu tư vào các lĩnh vực trọng điểm như công nghiệp chế biến, chế tạo, năng lượng, du lịch, nông nghiệp công nghệ cao. Nguồn nhân lực chất lượng cao được đào tạo và phát triển nhằm đáp ứng nhu cầu của các nhà đầu tư. Thanh Hóa cam kết tạo mọi điều kiện thuận lợi nhất để các nhà đầu tư đến tìm hiểu cơ hội và triển khai dự án, góp phần thúc đẩy phát triển kinh tế - xã hội của tỉnh.

This paper introduces a novel explanation-based weakly-supervised learning (EWSL) framework for visual relation detection, leveraging graph networks to reason about object interactions. Our method addresses the challenge of limited labeled data by utilizing readily available scene graph annotations as weak supervision. EWSL incorporates an explanation module that generates textual explanations for predicted relations, which are then used to refine the model's understanding of visual relationships. We employ graph convolutional networks (GCNs) to model the relationships between objects, enabling effective information propagation and reasoning. The explanation module provides crucial feedback, guiding the model to focus on relevant visual features and improving the accuracy of relation prediction. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate that our EWSL approach significantly outperforms existing weakly-supervised methods and achieves comparable performance to some fully-supervised techniques. The proposed framework offers a promising direction for learning visual relations with minimal annotation effort, facilitating the development of more robust and scalable vision systems. Keywords: visual relation detection, weakly-supervised learning, graph networks, explanation-based learning, scene graphs.

Mô hình khung thép được sử dụng rộng rãi trong xây dựng và kiến trúc để tạo nên các công trình vững chắc. Tuy nhiên, khi gắn thiết bị hệ cản khối lượng lên mô hình này, các yếu tố động lực học sẽ được ảnh hưởng đáng kể. Thí nghiệm được thực hiện để phân tích và đánh giá hiệu suất của mô hình khung thép khi gắn thiết bị hệ cản khối lượng. Kết quả thí nghiệm cho thấy rằng, khi gắn thiết bị hệ cản khối lượng lên mô hình khung thép, mô hình sẽ có khả năng chống chịu tốt hơn trước các tác động ngoại lực như gió, mưa, và các tải trọng khác. Đồng thời, mô hình cũng sẽ có khả năng hấp thụ và phân tán năng lượng tốt hơn, giúp giảm thiểu tác động của các tác động ngoại lực lên công trình. Phân tích động lực học mô hình khung thép có xét đến việc gắn thiết bị hệ cản khối lượng cho thấy rằng, mô hình này có khả năng đáp ứng tốt các yêu cầu về an toàn và ổn định trong xây dựng và kiến trúc. Tuy nhiên, cần phải tiếp tục nghiên cứu và thử nghiệm để có thể tối ưu hóa hiệu suất của mô hình này.

Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) agents often struggle to generalize to unseen environments, limiting their real-world applicability. This paper investigates the generalization capabilities of DRL agents trained using procedurally generated environments. We introduce a novel framework that combines deep reinforcement learning with procedural level generation (PLG) to systematically evaluate and improve generalization. Our approach involves training agents on a diverse set of environments generated through PLG and then assessing their performance on held-out, unseen environments. We analyze the impact of different PLG techniques on the agents' ability to generalize, focusing on factors such as environmental diversity and complexity. Results demonstrate that agents trained with carefully designed PLG strategies exhibit significantly improved generalization compared to those trained on a fixed set of environments or with naive PLG. Furthermore, we identify specific characteristics of procedural generation that contribute most effectively to enhanced generalization. This research provides valuable insights into the relationship between environmental diversity and generalization in DRL, paving the way for more robust and adaptable intelligent systems. Keywords: Deep Reinforcement Learning, Procedural Level Generation, Generalization, Artificial Intelligence, Game AI, Machine Learning.

This paper proposes a novel approach to microwave imaging of brain anomalies using a Graph Attention Network (GAN). The objective is to accurately detect and localize anomalies within the brain, such as tumors or hemorrhages, using microwave imaging techniques. Our approach employs a graph-based model that leverages attention mechanisms to focus on the most relevant features of the microwave data. The GAN is trained on a dataset of simulated and real-world microwave images, and its performance is evaluated against traditional imaging methods. Results show that the GAN achieves superior accuracy and robustness in anomaly detection, with significant improvements in sensitivity and specificity. The proposed method has important implications for the development of non-invasive and portable brain imaging systems, enabling early diagnosis and treatment of brain-related diseases. Key contributions of this research include the introduction of graph attention mechanisms to microwave imaging, and the demonstration of their potential in improving the accuracy and reliability of brain anomaly detection. Relevant keywords: Graph Attention Network, Microwave Imaging, Brain Anomaly Detection, Non-Invasive Imaging, Deep Learning.

The extraction of road curbs is a critical process in urban infrastructure management and autonomous vehicle navigation. This research focuses on developing a novel method for accurately identifying and extracting road curbs from mobile Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) point clouds, addressing the challenges posed by complex urban environments. Methods/Approach: We propose a robust algorithm that utilizes a combination of point cloud segmentation and geometric feature analysis to differentiate between road surfaces and curbs. The approach includes preprocessing steps that enhance point cloud density and accuracy, followed by segmentation using spatial clustering techniques to isolate potential curb candidates. Geometric feature descriptors are then applied to precisely detect curb edges, ensuring reduced noise and improved detection rates. Results/Findings: The proposed method was evaluated on diverse datasets collected in various urban settings, demonstrating superior performance over existing methods. Our approach achieved a curb detection accuracy of over 95%, with significant reductions in false positives due to the enhanced preprocessing and segmentation techniques. The algorithm maintained high efficiency, processing dense point clouds in real-time, which is critical for practical deployment in dynamic urban scenarios. Conclusion/Implications: This research contributes a significant advancement in the field of urban mapping and autonomous navigation by providing an efficient and accurate curb detection method from mobile LiDAR data. The findings have potential applications in smart city development, autonomous vehicle systems, and infrastructure monitoring. This innovative approach paves the way for further enhancements in automated mapping technologies, facilitating improved urban planning and management. Keywords: Mobile LiDAR, Point Clouds, Road Curb Extraction, Urban Environments, Autonomous Navigation, Geometric Feature Analysis, Segmentation.

This paper addresses the challenge of learning values that span multiple orders of magnitude, a common problem in various fields such as computer vision, natural language processing, and reinforcement learning. Our objective is to develop a novel approach that can effectively handle this issue, enabling more accurate and robust model performance. We propose a new method that combines a multi-scale architecture with a specially designed loss function, allowing the model to learn and represent values across a wide range of magnitudes. Our approach is evaluated on several benchmark datasets, demonstrating significant improvements in performance compared to existing methods. The results show that our model can learn values with high accuracy, even in the presence of large magnitude variations. This research contributes to the development of more robust and generalizable models, with potential applications in areas such as image and speech recognition, game playing, and autonomous systems. Key keywords: multi-scale learning, value representation, robust modeling, deep learning, reinforcement learning.

Thanh thành mỏng tiết diện hở khi chịu xoắn có thể mất ổn định do hiện tượng xoắn bị kiềm chế. Việc tính toán xoắn kiềm chế đòi hỏi xem xét đến các yếu tố như hình dạng tiết diện, vật liệu, điều kiện biên và tải trọng tác dụng. Các phương pháp phân tích thường được sử dụng bao gồm lý thuyết xoắn kỹ thuật, phương pháp phần tử hữu hạn và các phương pháp số khác. Kết quả tính toán cho phép xác định ứng suất xoắn, biến dạng xoắn, và hệ số xoắn kiềm chế, từ đó đánh giá khả năng chịu lực và độ ổn định của thanh. Quá trình thiết kế cần đảm bảo rằng ứng suất và biến dạng không vượt quá giới hạn cho phép, đồng thời hệ số xoắn kiềm chế phải đủ lớn để ngăn ngừa mất ổn định. Các phần mềm chuyên dụng hỗ trợ tính toán và phân tích xoắn kiềm chế, giúp kỹ sư đưa ra các quyết định thiết kế chính xác và an toàn. Việc hiểu rõ cơ chế xoắn kiềm chế là rất quan trọng trong thiết kế các kết cấu thanh thành mỏng, đặc biệt trong các ứng dụng hàng không, ô tô và xây dựng.

Current benchmarks for optical flow algorithms evaluate the estimation either directly by comparing the predicted flow fields with the ground truth or indirectly by using the predicted flow fields for frame interpolation and then comparing the interpolated frames with the actual frames. In the latter case, objective quality measures such as the mean squared error are typically employed. However, it is well known that for image quality assessment, the actual quality experienced by the user cannot be fully deduced from such simple measures. Hence, we conducted a subjective quality assessment crowdscouring study for the interpolated frames provided by one of the optical flow benchmarks, the Middlebury benchmark. We collected forced-choice paired comparisons between interpolated images and corresponding ground truth. To increase the sensitivity of observers when judging minute difference in paired comparisons we introduced a new method to the field of full-reference quality assessment, called artefact amplification. From the crowdsourcing data, we reconstructed absolute quality scale values according to Thurstone's model. As a result, we obtained a re-ranking of the 155 participating algorithms w.r.t. the visual quality of the interpolated frames. This re-ranking not only shows the necessity of visual quality assessment as another evaluation metric for optical flow and frame interpolation benchmarks, the results also provide the ground truth for designing novel image quality assessment (IQA) methods dedicated to perceptual quality of interpolated images. As a first step, we proposed such a new full-reference method, called WAE-IQA. By weighing the local differences between an interpolated image and its ground truth WAE-IQA performed slightly better than the currently best FR-IQA approach from the literature.
